page.content:
Rule-book number that teaches the code Philip and Hamilton later use.

How Ten Duel Commandments connects

  • Work: Hamilton (musical) — Ten Duel Commandments teaches the code the later duels use.
  • Character: Philip Hamilton — Philip follows the Ten Duel Commandments and dies by them.

What is Ten Duel Commandments?

Ten Duel Commandments is the instructional song that lays out the paces, the seconds, and the firing rules the show will spend twice — once for Philip, once for Hamilton and Burr.

Key threads lead to Hamilton (musical) and Philip Hamilton.
